semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in semiconductor CMP consumables, which are critical for wafer processing.
summary: Dongguan Yingxin Semiconductor Material Co., Ltd is a high-tech enterprise focused on the R&D, production, and sales of chemical mechanical polishing (CMP) consumables for the semiconductor industry. Their product offerings include advanced polishing pads and cloths designed for effective grinding and polishing of semiconductor wafers and other substrates.
capabilities: Damping cloths for effective pressure transmission
Non-woven polishing pads with polyurethane foaming structure
CMP retaining rings for wafer processing

regional_presence.China: The company has two major production bases located in Humen, Dongguan and Nantong, Jiangsu.
